C1639.title: Investigating Attacks on AR/VR Systems: A Forensic Methodology
C1639.summary: A study on forensic investigation of attacks targeting AR/VR systems, demonstrating the effectiveness of its methodology through two case studies. The research unifies logs across the AR/VR software stack to analyze and investigate attack behaviors against these systems.

references.title: Principled and Automated Approach for Investigating AR/VR Attacks
